# 數學 / Mathematics: course outline

**Version 1, 2026-11-15.** 12 parts, 53 chapters, about 26 hours of lessons.  
Core: 0 parts, 0 chapters. Tracks: sprint-116, ast-tools.  
Papers: mathA, mathB. Paths: 數A (`mathA`), 數B (`mathB`). Status: pilot.

## Decisions

- 116 sprint first (owner, 2026-11-15): review chapters for students who studied grade 10–11 in school; the full zero-to-hero core follows for 117.
- Codes shared by 11A and 11B are reviewed in one chapter on both paths (math map D1).
- ★/＃ codes (N-10-5, N-10-7, G-10-1, D-10-1) are reviewed as short toolbox chapters or inside a related chapter; ※ material (cot/sec/csc, the Cauchy note) is left out of the sprint.
- Practice papers are original and only modelled on the 111–115 layout; official papers are linked, never copied.
- Outline approved by the owner on 2026-11-15 (S1 gate).
- Owner approved (2026-11-16) the cross-unit part and the optional 分科 advanced-tools track (docs/curriculum/math-extensions-proposal.md).

## Open questions

1. Exam-item links (examItems) are added per chapter in S2 from src/data/registry/exam/items/math.json.
2. Reviewed concepts (reviews) are added per chapter in S2, once their glossary entries exist.

### Part 11: 12 年級的好用工具 / Handy grade-12 tools (track ast-tools)

**Question:** 12 年級的工具，能怎麼幫你解學測題？ / How can grade-12 tools help with GSAT problems?  
**Track:** 選修小技巧 / Elective tricks. Starts after `math/s116-mixed-items`: 選讀。每章從零教一個 12 年級（數甲／數乙）的觀念，並說明它能讓哪些學測題算得更快或多一種檢查；學測的每一題仍然只用 10～11 年級的方法就能解。 / Optional. Each chapter teaches one grade-12 (Math 甲/乙) idea from zero and shows which GSAT problems it speeds up or double-checks; every GSAT problem is still solvable with grade 10–11 methods.  

*Why here:* Owner requirement 2026-11-16: 分科 material only as advanced tools for 學測, taught from zero, labelled 不考學測. Codes and depth limits from research/math-12-electives-2026-11-16.md; ※ items excluded.
